annotations.title: TIA — export one block or type (SIMATIC SD, inline)

description: Exports ONE block (OB, FB, FC, DB) or PLC data type as SIMATIC SD text, INLINE: `s7dcl` (the code; LAD/FBD as NETWORK ... RUNG text) and `s7res` (YAML texts; null when TIA wrote none) with byte counts, state, messages and `contentHash`: the SAME stale-write hash tia_export_block and tia_export_type return (null with contentHashError when the block is not consistent or the object changed while it was exported: read it again), to pass as expectedContentHash to tia_import_sd; it is not a hash of this text, never substitute another hash. TIA V20+ (types V21+). Never compiles or changes the project (it works in a scratch folder on the serve host, removed best effort: one that cannot be removed stays in the temp folder, unlogged). 404 not_found; 409 inconsistent (a type), know_how_protected, sd_export_failed (details.state, details.messages: TIA's own words), sd_not_supported. TIA re-quotes some identifiers on export (`a` returns as "a"): compare ignoring quotes. Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/blocks/{block}/sd and /plcs/{plc}/types/{type}/sd. Class R. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

kind.description: block (OB, FB, FC, global or instance DB) or type (a PLC data type)

plc.description: PLC software name from tia_plcs.name, not the device station name
